The value

Golf is a four-hour conversation

A round means four hours on the course with three other people. That's why companies take clients out for a round, and why so many business relationships are built on the course. We want every student to have that time, whatever their level.

01

Start from zero

About half the people at our events have never played. We bring the clubs and show you the basics, so all you need to do is turn up.

02

Meet people in the industry

At our corporate events, students and professionals play in the same group. A round of eighteen holes gives you time for a proper conversation.

03

Play for Nova SBE

Our golf team plays against other universities. In November it finished 1st in the Team Net at the Bocconi & Friends Golf Cup in Milan.

Our mission

Your first swing doesn't have to count

Our mission is to make golf easy to get into for every Nova SBE student, whatever their experience, budget or background. Golf is one of the best places to make business connections, but students rarely get the chance to play. A round costs more than a night out, a set of clubs costs more than a semester of textbooks, and nobody writes the etiquette down, so you only learn it if you already know someone who plays.

That's what we're here to fix. We help students find better rates, provide clubs for beginners, and run formats where a first-timer and an experienced player can enjoy the same afternoon.

Our vision is simple. We want every Nova SBE student to be able to say yes when someone suggests a round of golf, whether they started last week or are already experienced players.

Formats

What our events are like

Clinic

Two hours, no pressure

You get a coach, a basket of balls and clubs to borrow. You're on the driving range, not the course, so nobody is waiting behind you. Most of our members started here.

Scramble

Teams of four, one ball

Everyone hits, the team picks the best shot, and everyone plays their next shot from there. A beginner in the group is an advantage, because they only need one good shot per hole.

Simulator

Indoors and scored for you

A screen, a mat and a launch monitor. It's cheap, it works in any weather, and it's the easiest way to compete without needing a handicap.

Stroke play

Everyone counts their own shots

This is golf in its standard form, and it's what the golf team plays. We only use it for tournaments, because a round takes five hours and strongly favours experienced players.

Selection

How to join the team

The team plays stroke play off official handicaps. We select players on the course, and this season's team was chosen at the Road to Milan trial, a 9-hole round at Swing & Sip on 15 October.

If you have a handicap and want to be considered, email us your current handicap index, your latest official scores and where you play. We'll get back to you.

Why we're considering a scramble

In a scramble the team plays the best shot every time. A student who has never played can join your group without slowing it down, and your staff won't spend four hours watching someone struggle. Everyone talks all the way round, which is the purpose of the day. We'll confirm the final format closer to the date.

Privacy policy

Nova Golf Club website. Version 1.0 | Last updated 26 October 2026.

Scope

This privacy policy applies to the processing of personal data of visitors to and users of the Nova Golf Club website and of people who contact the Nova Golf Club through it.

Who are we?

Nova Golf Club is a registered student club of Nova SBE Students’ Union, with tax number 501 662 219, located in Campus de Carcavelos, Rua da Holanda 1, 2775-405 Carcavelos.

Nova SBE Students’ Union is the controller of the personal data processed in connection with the Nova Golf Club activities, within the meaning given to that expression in data protection legislation.

What are the purposes of the processing?

We process personal data for the following purposes:

  1. Operating the website and keeping it secure, including delivering the website’s pages to your device through the automatic processing of technical data such as your IP address, browser and device information, as well as detecting and preventing misuse, attacks and technical faults;
  2. Responding to enquiries from companies and other organisations by processing the information you choose to send us, to reply to you and, where applicable, to discuss and conclude sponsorship or partnership arrangements;
  3. Presenting the Nova Golf Club committee by publishing names, roles, photographs and social media profile links;
  4. Sharing the Nova Golf Club activities and events, for example by publishing photographs taken at events;
  5. Selecting players for the club’s competitive squad during trials, where a panel of committee members assesses participants’ capability;
  6. Organising and managing events and trials.

Any further use of personal data for a different purpose will be assessed against the criteria set out in Article 6(4) of the GDPR.

You are not legally obliged to provide your personal data. However, where information is needed to achieve the purposes above, we will not be able to do so without it.

What is the legal basis for the processing?

The processing of personal data by Nova SBE Students’ Union is based on the following legal grounds:

  • the legitimate interests pursued by the Nova SBE Students’ Union or by third parties, namely the interest in ensuring the operation and security of the website, selecting players for the club’s competitive squad and replying to the enquiries received, including, where applicable, to discuss and conclude sponsorship or partnership arrangements, except where such interests are overridden by the interests or fundamental rights and freedoms of the data subject which require the protection of personal data;
  • the performance of a contract to which the data subject is party, or steps taken at the data subject’s request before entering into a contract for the purposes of organising and managing events and trials;
  • the consent of committee members to publish their photograph for the purposes of presenting the Nova Golf Club committee, and the consent of students to capture and publish their image for the purposes of sharing club activities and events.

Where none of the other legal grounds is suitable to support the processing, Nova SBE Students’ Union will only process personal data if it has obtained your consent to process personal data for specific, explicit and legitimate purposes.

You may request information about the criteria applied to determine our legitimate interests by contacting golf.club@novasbe.pt.

Who do we share personal data with?

In the course of its activities, Nova SBE Students’ Union shares personal data with processors, other controllers and joint controllers. These include the following:

  • Website hosting provider;
  • Tournament and cup organisers, including Bocconi & Friends Golf Cup, only in respect of players selected for an external tournament who choose to enter;
  • Social media platforms;
  • Online forms provider, used to receive registrations for events and trials;
  • Event venues, transport providers and insurers;
  • Public, judicial or administrative authorities, where there is a legal obligation to disclose your personal data.

Do we transfer personal data outside the EEA?

Some of our service providers are established, or process data, outside the European Economic Area (EEA). These transfers are carried out in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation. Where the destination country does not provide a level of protection equivalent to that of the European Union, Nova SBE Students’ Union ensures that appropriate safeguards are in place, such as an adequacy decision by the European Commission or, in its absence, the Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the Commission.

You can obtain more information about these safeguards by contacting golf.club@novasbe.pt. The providers concerned are our website host, our online forms provider and the social media platforms we use.

How long do we keep personal data?

Nova SBE Students’ Union keeps personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected.

The retention periods applicable to each purpose are:

  • Website technical access data: for the period defined by the hosting service provider under its terms and internal privacy policies;
  • Enquiries from companies and other organisations: until the end of the academic year in which the enquiry was received or, where a sponsorship or partnership arrangement is concluded, for the duration of that arrangement and any period required by law thereafter;
  • Committee members’ information: for the duration of the member’s term and subsequently removed from the website within seven days after the member leaves the committee;
  • Event photographs: for as long as the event is being promoted and reviewed at the end of each academic year, when photographs no longer needed are deleted. Photographs that are not selected for publication are deleted within seven days of the event.
  • Event and trial registration data: until the event or trial to which the registration relates has taken place, after which the data is securely deleted within 7 (seven) days.

What are the rights of data subjects?

Data subjects may, at any time, exercise a set of rights under the terms and conditions provided for by law. These include the right to object, often exercised in relation to certain types of communication, as well as the rights of access, portability, erasure, restriction of processing and rectification. In addition, data subjects have the right to withdraw their consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.

These rights may be exercised by e-mail to golf.club@novasbe.pt, the contact point designated by Nova SBE Students’ Union, or to the Union at clubs.su@novasbe.pt, or by post to the Union at Campus de Carcavelos, Rua da Holanda 1, 2775-405 Carcavelos. We will reply within one month of receiving your request.

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Portuguese data protection authority, Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados, at https://www.cnpd.pt/.

Changes to this privacy policy

This privacy policy may be updated. Data subjects will be informed within a reasonable period whenever the changes represent a fundamental change in the nature of the processing, such as a change in the purposes of the processing, a change in the identity of the controller or an extension of the categories of recipients.

Legal

Cookie policy

Short version: this site does not use cookies.

This website does not set cookies, and it does not use browser storage (such as local storage) to track you, remember you between visits, or serve you advertising. Nothing about how you use this site is recorded by us or shared with a third party for tracking purposes.

Links on this site may take you to third-party pages we do not control, such as Instagram, Google Maps or LinkedIn. Those sites have their own cookie and privacy practices, which this policy does not cover.

If this ever changes, for example if we add analytics or an embedded tool that sets cookies, we will update this page first and explain what is being set and why.

Questions about this policy can be sent to golf.club@novasbe.pt.

Terms of use

The basics of using this website.

This website is run by NOVA Golf Club, a registered student club at Nova SBE, to share information about the club, its events, and how to get involved or partner with us. It is not an official page of Nova SBE or NOVA University Lisbon.

Content on this site, including text, photos and the club logo, belongs to NOVA Golf Club unless stated otherwise, and should not be reused elsewhere without asking first. Photos from club events may include identifiable students; if you appear in a photo and would like it removed, contact us and we will take it down.

Prices, dates, capacity and other event details on this site are kept as current as we can manage, but things can change on short notice. Where a figure is not yet confirmed, we mark it as such rather than guessing.

Links to third-party sites, such as our partner course or social media, are provided for convenience. We are not responsible for the content or practices of sites we do not control.

This site, its content and any forms on it are provided as is, without guarantees. We do our best to keep information accurate, but errors can happen, and we are not liable for decisions made based on information found here.

Questions about these terms can be sent to golf.club@novasbe.pt.

Legal

Accessibility

We want this site to be usable for everyone, and we are still working on it.

NOVA Golf Club is a small, volunteer-run student club, and this site is maintained by students alongside their studies. We have tried to build it with accessibility in mind: clear text contrast, readable type sizes, a layout that works on mobile as well as desktop, and semantic structure so screen readers can navigate it.

This is not a formal accessibility audit, and there will be gaps we have not caught. If something on this site is hard to use, hard to read, or does not work with the assistive technology you use, please tell us. We will do our best to fix it, and student volunteer capacity means fixes may take time rather than happening immediately.

Report an accessibility issue to golf.club@novasbe.pt, with a description of the problem and, if possible, which page it is on and what device or software you were using.
